new_this_pass.note: Attack 8 NM north of Khasab, outbound tanker struck on the port bow by an unknown projectile, fire onboard, no casualties, no environmental impact reported. Explicit incident date 20 Nov (same-day report). Matches Tampa FP/Reuters wire of Nov 20 ("tanker heading out of the Strait of Hormuz caught fire Friday").
Attack 11 NM north of Khasab, outbound tanker hit on the stern by an unknown projectile, no casualties, environmental impact unconfirmed. Same-day report; explicit incident date 21 Nov.

Attack 17 NM east of Khasab, outbound tanker hit in the engine room by an unknown projectile, no casualties, environmental impact unconfirmed. Same-day report; explicit incident date 21 Nov. Business Upturn could not rule out #215/#216 being the same vessel; the API lists them as separate warnings with distinct positions.
